title: Cinderwing and the Last Ember
description: An obsidian dragon shelters its glowing egg beneath raised scalloped crimson wings. A sweeping neck, open fanged jaw, ivory horns, plated haunches and a hooked tail give the guardian a powerful silhouette.

sections.name: Four planted clawed feet and muscular limbs
Rounded cuirass and segmented ember belly
Horned head, glowing eyes and open fanged jaw
